value: U2OS GR alpha, CORT, biological replicate 1
U2OS Flp-In T-REx GR knockout rescue line
cell line: U2OS Flp-In T-REx GR knockout rescue line
genotype: GR knockout U2OS rescued with wild-type GR alpha
DMSO vehicle or 100 nM corticosterone was added as indicated. After 1 h at 37°C, 4-thiouridine was added to 1 mM and cells were incubated for exactly 30 min before RNA collection.

Human U2OS Flp-In T-REx GR-knockout rescue lines were cultured in high-glucose DMEM containing 10% HyClone FetalClone II bovine serum and penicillin/streptomycin at 37°C with 5% CO₂. Flp-In T-REx lines were maintained with 50 ug/mL hygromycin and GR transgene expression was induced with 1 ug/mL doxycycline for at least 24 h. For RNA sequencing, cells were seeded at high density in 15 cm dishes, grown to confluence, entrained for 4-7 days using alternating cycles of 12 h at 37°C and 12 h at 32°C, then incubated at constant 37°C for at least 24 h before sampling.
3 mL TRIzol was added to cells, and the resulting lysates were snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at -70°C. Total RNA was extracted by phenol-chloroform precipitation and quantified by Qubit.
Human U2OS mRNA sequencing was performed by Novogene.
Biological replicate 1. Matched assay sample: TT_human_alpha_CORT_rep1. The processed count file contains gene-level unnormalised counts.
Reads were adapter-trimmed and quality-filtered using Trim Galore v0.6.7 with a Phred quality cutoff of 30.
Trimmed reads were aligned in two-pass mode to hg38 using STAR v2.7.9a. Multimapping reads were randomly assigned and restricted to a single alignment.
Alignments were sorted and indexed with SAMtools v1.9.
Gene-level raw counts were quantified using HTSeq v2.0.5 against Ensembl GRCh38 release 102; only exonic reads were counted.

Replicate-level 10-bp bigWigs were generated from BAMs using deepTools bamCoverage with DESeq2-derived scale factors. For each condition, normalised replicate bigWigs were summed with UCSC bigWigMerge, the resulting bedGraph signal was divided by the number of summed replicates to obtain the arithmetic mean, coordinates were sorted and restricted to the hg38 chromosome sizes, and the final bigWig was generated with UCSC bedGraphToBigWig.
Supplementary files format and content: .txt files: tab-delimited gene-level unnormalised raw read counts from HTSeq v2.0.5; only exonic reads were counted.
Supplementary files format and content: .bw files: condition-level arithmetic-mean coverage tracks at 10-bp resolution. Replicate tracks were scaled using DESeq2-derived factors before averaging.
